environment: Linux cloud container, 4 vCPU. Real C# five-node render lab (presentation profile, real 500 kWh, heat need per run), test-only Linux launcher; Blender 5.3.0 = bpy module behind a test-only native launcher; each frame render replaced by a fixed 2.0 s placeholder. NOT the presentation laptop.
method: Fresh lab per side; 3 consecutive 48-frame runs through /ui/render; outcomes counted from the GPU peers' mesh journals, proposals from origin job generations; CPU = user+system seconds per .NET node process per run. BEFORE = checkout of origin/main 6f3ba99; AFTER = same plus ADR 0074 (before review fixes; final code then re-verified in the off/on runs).
off_on_rejections: 1 proposal rejected by GPU 3 while it was being fenced; re-planned once.
limits: Wall time on Linux is unchanged because fsync is cheap here; the expected Windows gain (fewer forced journal writes per frame) is not measured.
